raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Purpose

`inclusionAI/Ling-3.0-flash-VL-fp4` fails at weight loading on every platform:

```
RuntimeError: The size of tensor a (3) must match the size of tensor b (12) at non-singleton dimension 1
  (routed_experts.py, _load_w2)
```

The routed experts are MXFP4 (`routed_experts_quant_method: mxfp4`). `_configure_ling_fp8_quant_config` reads that from `config.quantization_config`, but the VL model builds its language model from `text_config`, which has no `quantization_config` (it lives on the top-level VL config). The helper returns early, `store_dtype` stays unset, and the experts get `Fp8MoEMethod` instead of `Mxfp4MoEMethod`. The same bug makes the model OOM at TP=1, because FP8 expert buffers are ~2x the MXFP4 size.

This PR makes the helper fall back to the current vLLM config's top-level `hf_config` when the config it receives has no `quantization_config`. Text-only Ling and the MTP draft (whose config already carries `quantization_config`) are unchanged.


## Test Plan

- Existing config tests: `pytest tests/transformers_utils/test_bailing_moe_v3_vl_config.py`
- End to end on Intel XPU (4x Arc Pro B70, TP=4, `vllm/vllm-openai-xpu:nightly-29468dde`):
  - Serve: `vllm serve inclusionAI/Ling-3.0-flash-VL-fp4 --dtype bfloat16 --tensor-parallel-size 4 --max-model-len 5756 --gpu-memory-utilization 0.85 --trust-remote-code --enforce-eager --limit-mm-per-prompt '{"image": 1}' --no-enable-prefix-caching`, then one text and one image chat request.
  - Accuracy: `lm_eval --model vllm --model_args pretrained=inclusionAI/Ling-3.0-flash-VL-fp4,tensor_parallel_size=4,dtype=bfloat16,trust_remote_code=True,max_model_len=4096,gpu_memory_utilization=0.85,enforce_eager=True --tasks gsm8k --batch_size auto`

## Test Result

Existing `tests/transformers_utils/test_bailing_moe_v3_vl_config.py`: ✓ 6/6 PASS

End to end (XPU, TP=4):

| | stock | this PR |
|---|---|---|
| MoE backend | `TRITON Fp8 MoE` | ✓ `XPU Mxfp4 MoE` |
| Load | FAIL, error above on all ranks | ✓ 16.51 GiB/rank, KV cache 693,767 tokens |
| Text / image chat | — | ✓ correct answers (`3+5-2` → `6`; red square top left, blue circle bottom right) |
| gsm8k (5-shot) flexible / strict | — | ✓ 0.8362 ± 0.0102 / 0.8249 ± 0.0105 |

For reference, the text sibling `Ling-3.0-flash-fp8` scores 0.8302 / 0.7688 on gsm8k.

nodes.body: @jikunshang, could you review this bug fix, please? Thanks a lot!
what's the behavior on cuda wo this fix?

@jikunshang It fails on CUDA too, with the same root cause: without the fix the experts get `Fp8MoEMethod` instead of `Mxfp4MoEMethod`. All runs on 1x B200, TP=1:

  | Fix | MoE backend | Result |
  |---|---|---|
  | no | `FLASHINFER_TRTLLM Fp8` | `size of tensor a (6) must match the size of tensor b (24)` in `_load_w2` |
  | yes | `FLASHINFER_TRTLLM_MXFP4_MXFP8` (auto) | loads 65.16 GiB, then fails at first forward: `Routing kernel expects #experts per group <= warp size (32), got 512 experts / 8 groups = 64` |
  | yes | `TRITON` (`--moe-backend triton`) | rejected at init: `does not support MoEActivation.SILU activation` |
  | yes | `FLASHINFER_CUTLASS_MXFP4_MXFP8` (`--moe-backend flashinfer_cutlass`) | loads 65.16 GiB, text + image OK, gsm8k 5-shot 0.8423 / 0.8287 |

  For reference, XPU TP=4 with the fix: gsm8k 0.8362 / 0.8249.

  The TRTLLM routing failure is a separate issue: the backend is selected without checking the experts-per-group limit. It's not related to this PR; I can open a follow-up for it.
@jikunshang, okay, I've just removed test with b5b1432

detail.title: [Bugfix] Read Ling quantization_config from top-level config for Bailing V3 VL

files.patch:
@@ -20,7 +20,13 @@
 from transformers.configuration_utils import PreTrainedConfig
 
 from vllm.compilation.decorators import support_torch_compile
-from vllm.config import CacheConfig, ModelConfig, VllmConfig, get_current_vllm_config
+from vllm.config import (
+    CacheConfig,
+    ModelConfig,
+    VllmConfig,
+    get_current_vllm_config,
+    get_current_vllm_config_or_none,
+)
 from vllm.distributed import (
     get_pp_group,
     get_tensor_model_parallel_rank,
@@ -230,6 +236,12 @@ def _configure_ling_fp8_quant_config(
 
     quant_config.ignored_layers_match_mode = "suffix"
     hf_quant_config = getattr(config, "quantization_config", None)
+    if hf_quant_config is None:
+        vllm_config = get_current_vllm_config_or_none()
+        model_config = getattr(vllm_config, "model_config", None)
+        hf_quant_config = getattr(
+            getattr(model_config, "hf_config", None), "quantization_config", None
+        )
     if not isinstance(hf_quant_config, dict):
         return
